task.title: Go live
task.description:
## Why
A final check that nothing needed for a public launch was skipped.

## Steps
1. Confirm Sleeper's answer on terms allows the launch as planned.
2. Build reports for one league of each fixture type on production and compare them with the CLI.
3. Try the site on a phone, on a slow connection, and in a private window.
4. Confirm the daily data workflow ran last night and that its failures notify someone.
5. Confirm the privacy and credits pages are live.
6. Announce the site.

## Done when
- Every item above is checked off in a comment on this task.
